text:
marco (partnerships): Kuiper granted early-access marketplace preview. NDA signed (kuiper-preview-v1). We need a concise handoff pack: container + checksums, perf targets, and telemetry constraints. Please triage owners below. Link: https://drive.redwood/kuiper/preview (internal)

tara (solutions): Proposed benchmark matrix:
- scenario A: single-client low-latency 2k-8k context
- scenario B: multi-client sustained throughput (100 concurrent)
- scenario C: edge-memory profile (batch=1, 4GB avail)
Quantization: start q4_0, verify int8 path. Capture p50/p90/p99, tok/sec, and memory RSS.

mike (legal): NDA check: privacy + telemetry ok but Kuiper wants 45-day retention on perf logs. Need to align with our default 90d. I'll flag the change and propose a redline.

lee (eng-runtime): Infra asks: exact image tag, model.tar.gz sha256, runtime env vars (CUDA, kernel flags). I'll also need expected max sequence length and kv-cache prewarm guidance.

rachel (eng-ml): I'll prepare the regression prompt set and automated eval harness. Adding warm vs cold cache runs makes sense. Also suggest adding a small adversarial prompt bucket to catch regressions.

marco (partnerships): Owners: Legal = @mike; Infra/runtime = @lee; ML harness = @rachel; Solutions/comms = @tara. Please post ETAs in thread. Planning a 30m handoff Fri 09:00 PT.

mike (legal): Redline posted: accept retention at 60 days (compromise). Also added clause: no raw customer PII in perf payloads.

rachel (eng-ml): Bench harness checklist (uploaded):
- prompts.csv (baseline + adversarial)
- harness.py -> run_suites(['latency','throughput','memory'])
- metrics exporter -> prometheus + csv
I will include warm/cold KV scripts. ETA Thu EOD.

lee (eng-runtime): Ops snippet to push image and run quick smoke:
```
IMAGE=redwood/kuiper-preview:2026-03-01
sha256=3b7f8a9c2d4e6f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5
./ci/push-image.sh $IMAGE --sha=$sha256 --target=kuiper-sandbox
# smoke
kubectl -n kuiper exec deploy/kuiper-smoke -- /app/smoke.sh --context=2048
```
Service account created: iam-kuiper-sandbox@redwood (granted).

deploy-bot: Sandbox cluster 'kuiper-sandbox' provisioned in us-east-1. Token expires in 8d.

tara (solutions): Comms plan: no public mention until post-validated metrics. Internal partner brief and embargo window: 3 weeks after successful bench. Draft in /docs/kuiper/comms. Need partner marketing + legal sign-off.

marco (partnerships): Can we set perf bar targets? Propose: p50 < 30ms (2k ctx), p95 < 120ms, sustained 400 tok/s per GPU for throughput. If ML/infra want different numbers propose here.

rachel (eng-ml): Those targets OK as starting goals. I'll capture exact measurement methodology in bench README.

lee (eng-runtime): I'll instrument token-level breakdown and cost-per-token calc. Also will enable cache prefill helper script. ETA Wed noon PT to upload runbook to drive.

mike (legal): I'll finalize the NDA redline and send countersigned copy by Thu.

marco (partnerships): Great. Final action items recap (dropping ETAs):
- mike (legal): finalize NDA redline -> Thu EOD
- lee (eng-runtime): image + runbook uploaded -> Wed 12:00 PT
- rachel (eng-ml): harness + prompts -> Thu EOD
- tara (solutions): embargo + comms draft -> Thu 09:00 PT
I'll book the Fri 09:00 PT handoff now. :calendar:

deploy-bot: Calendar invite created for Fri 09:00 PT: Handoff - Kuiper marketplace preview.
